title: Multiplayer localization catalog
description: Defines the structure and text values for this localization catalog.

$schema.description: Relative path to the schema for this catalog.

CreatedMatch.description: Confirms match creation, sets the caller's target, and adds them as a referee. {0} is the match ID, {1} is the room name, and {2} is an optional privacy label.

NoActiveMatchWithId.description: Reply when the requested match ID is not active. {0} is the ID.

PrivateRoomJoinDenied.description: Explains that joining a private match requires an invite. {0} is the match ID.

AlreadyInAMatch.description: Reply when the player is already in a match.

BannedFromMatch.description: Reply when the player is banned from the match.

JoinedMatch.description: Confirms that the player joined a match. {0} is the match ID and {1} is the room name.

IncorrectPassword.description: Reply when the match password is incorrect.

MatchIsFull.description: Reply when the match has no open player slots.

MatchIsLocked.description: Reply when the match is locked against joining.

FailedToJoinMatch.description: Reply when the player cannot join the match.

FailedToJoinMatchChat.description: Reply when the player joins the match but cannot join its chat.

JoinedMatchChat.description: Confirms entry to the match chat. {0} is the match ID and {1} is the room name.

JoinRequiresClient.description: Explains that joining a match requires the osu! client.

AlreadyInAnotherRoom.description: Explains that the player must leave their current match first.

Url.description: Replies for joining a match by ID.

NotScopedToAnyMatch.description: Reply when the caller has no target match.

YouAreARefereeOf.description: Heading for the list of matches where the caller is a referee.

InUsage.description: Usage message for !mp in, with an optional match ID.

NoActiveMatchWithHashId.description: Reply when the requested match ID is not active. {0} is the ID.

NotARefereeOfMatch.description: Reply when the caller is not a referee of the requested match. {0} is the match ID.

NowTargetingMatch.description: Confirms the selected target match. {0} is the match ID and {1} is the room name.

In.description: Replies for choosing or reporting the match targeted by !mp commands.

SettingsRoomName.description: Displays the room name and match ID. {0} is the name and {1} is the ID.

SettingsBeatmap.description: Displays the selected beatmap and its identifying details.

SettingsBeatmapNotFound.description: Beatmap summary shown when the selected beatmap cannot be found.

SettingsBeatmapNotSelected.description: Beatmap summary shown when no beatmap is selected.

SettingsTeamMode.description: Displays the team mode and win condition. {0} is the team mode and {1} is the win condition.

SettingsActiveMods.description: Displays the match's active mods. {0} is the mod list.

SettingsCreator.description: Displays the match creator. {0} is the account ID and {1} is the player name.

SettingsPlayers.description: Displays the player count. {0} is the count.

SettingsIrc.description: Displays the match's IRC details. {0} is the IRC value.

Settings.description: Labels and values shown in a match settings summary.

LockedMatch.description: Confirms that the match was locked.

UnlockedMatch.description: Confirms that the match was unlocked.

SizeUsage.description: Usage message for !mp size, including the allowed range.

ChangedMatchSize.description: Confirms the new slot count. {0} is the size.

Lock.description: Replies for locking a match and changing its slot count.

UserNotInMatchOrUnregistered.description: Reply when the target is not registered or is not in this match.

DestinationSlotNotOpen.description: Reply when the requested destination slot is unavailable.

NotInThisMatch.description: Reply when the named player is not in this match. {0} is the player name.

MovedToSlot.description: Confirms a player's new slot. {0} is the player name and {1} is the slot number.

ChangedMatchHost.description: Confirms the new host. {0} is the player name.

ClearedMatchHost.description: Confirms that the match host was cleared.

Move.description: Replies for moving players between slots and changing the host.

RoomNameUpdated.description: Confirms the new room name. {0} is the name.

RemovedMatchPassword.description: Confirms that the match password was removed.

ChangedMatchPassword.description: Confirms that the match password was changed.

MatchIsPrivateNow.description: Reports the match's current privacy state. {0} is the state.

MatchNowPrivate.description: Confirms that the match is private and explains who can see or join it.

MatchNowPublic.description: Confirms that the match is public.

PrivateUsage.description: Usage message for !mp private, including its accepted values.

Name.description: Replies for changing the room name, password, and privacy.

InviteRequiresClient.description: Explains that the invite target must be connected through the osu! client.

UserAlreadyInRoom.description: Reply when the invite target is already in the match.

CannotInviteBot.description: Reply when BasilBot is selected as the invite target.

InvitedToRoom.description: Confirms that a player was invited. {0} is the player name.

Invite.description: Replies for inviting players to a match.

UserNotFound.description: Reply when the requested referee account cannot be found.

CannotAddBotReferee.description: Reply when BasilBot is selected as a referee.

AddedReferee.description: Confirms that a referee was added. {0} is the player name.

TargetIsAlreadyAReferee.description: Reply when the target is already a referee. {0} is the player name.

CannotRemoveLastReferee.description: Explains that the last referee cannot be removed. {0} is the player name.

TargetIsNotAReferee.description: Reply when the target is not a referee. {0} is the player name.

CannotRemoveCreator.description: Explains that a match creator cannot be removed as a referee. {0} is the player name.

RemovedReferee.description: Confirms that a referee was removed. {0} is the player name.

NoReferees.description: Empty-state text when the match has no referees.

MatchReferees.description: Heading for the list of match referees.

NoBannedPlayers.description: Empty-state text when the match has no banned players.

MatchBans.description: Heading for the list of players banned from the match.

Referee.description: Replies for adding and removing referees and listing match bans.

TeamUsage.description: Usage message for !mp team with a player ID or name.

TeamUsageName.description: Usage message for !mp team with a player name.

MovedToTeam.description: Confirms a team assignment. {0} is the player name and {1} is the team.

SetUsage.description: Usage message for !mp set, including accepted setting ranges.

ChangedMatchSettings.description: Confirms the new team mode and win condition, with an optional slot count.

Team.description: Replies for assigning teams and changing match settings.

NoBeatmapWithId.description: Reply when the requested beatmap ID is not found. {0} is the ID.

ChangedBeatmap.description: Confirms the selected beatmap. The placeholders contain its artist, title, and difficulty version.

ModsUsage.description: Usage message for !mp mods, including FreeMod and None options.

EnabledMods.description: Confirms which mods were enabled. {0} is the mod list.

DisabledMods.description: Confirms which mods were disabled. {0} is the mod list.

NoModChanges.description: Reply when the requested mod change leaves the mod set unchanged.

Map.description: Replies for choosing a beatmap and changing mods.

MatchAlreadyInProgress.description: Reply when a match is already underway.

MatchStartsInSeconds.description: Countdown notice before a match starts. {0} is the number of seconds remaining.

MatchStarted.description: Confirms that the match has started.

CountdownStarted.description: Confirms that a countdown started. {0} is its duration in seconds.

NoCountdownRunning.description: Reply when there is no countdown to abort.

CountdownAborted.description: Confirms that the countdown was aborted.

MatchNotInProgress.description: Reply when an operation requires a match in progress.

AbortedMatch.description: Confirms that the match was aborted.

NoBeatmapSelected.description: Reply when starting a match requires a selected beatmap.

Start.description: Replies for starting, timing, and aborting a match.

CannotKickBot.description: Reply when BasilBot is selected as the kick target.

CannotKickReferee.description: Explains that referees cannot be kicked until their referee role is removed. {0} is the player name.

KickedFromMatch.description: Confirms that a player was kicked. {0} is the player name.

UserNotRegistered.description: Reply when the ban target has no registered account.

CannotBanBot.description: Reply when BasilBot is selected as the ban target.

CannotBanReferee.description: Explains that referees cannot be banned until their referee role is removed. {0} is the player name.

BannedPlayerFromMatch.description: Confirms that a player was banned from the match. {0} is the player name.

NotBannedFromMatch.description: Reply when the target is not banned from this match. {0} is the player name.

UnbannedFromMatch.description: Confirms that a player was unbanned. {0} is the player name.

ClosedMatch.description: Confirms that the match was closed.

Moderation.description: Replies for kicking, banning, unbanning, and closing a match.

NotInARoom.description: Reply when a command requires the caller to be in a match.

NotScopedToAnyMatchHint.description: Guides the caller to create, join, or select a match before using !mp commands.

UnknownMpSubcommand.description: Reply when !mp receives an unknown subcommand. {0} is the unrecognized command.

CreatorOnlyMp.description: Explains that the requested operation is restricted to the match creator. {0} is the operation.

MpNotUsableFromLobby.description: Explains that a command cannot be run from #lobby. {0} is the subcommand.

MpChainNotUsableFromLobby.description: Explains that chained !mp commands cannot be run from #lobby.

MpInDmOnly.description: Explains that !mp in must be sent in a direct message to BasilBot.

ChainMustBeMp.description: Explains that a chain may contain only !mp commands. {0} is the command prefix and {1} is the rejected segment.

CannotChainMp.description: Explains that a subcommand cannot be chained. {0} is the prefix, {1} is the subcommand, and {2} is the rejected segment.

General.description: Replies for match context, command availability, and chained-command errors.
